title: Digital Psychology and Education Conference
about: Elsevier's first Digital Psychology and Education Conference (DPEC 2027), themed "Advancing Human Society in an AI-Powered World", takes place 17-20 June 2027 in Shenzhen, China. Abstracts are due 8 January 2027 according to the Participate page; the main page states 22 January 2027.

upskill.name: AI Fundamentals for Education
why: "Digital psychology and education" → "Explore practical opportunities for AI across teaching, learning, assessment, student support, research, and academic administration."

"Advancing Human Society in an AI-Powered World" (conference theme) → "Understand the capabilities, limitations, risks, and principles of responsible AI use in schools, universities, training organizations, and other learning environments."

card_alt: Card for the "Digital Psychology and Education Conference" by Elsevier in Shenzhen, China; abstract deadline 8 Jan 2027. The photo shows the gate of Shuhe Ancient Town in Lijiang, not Shenzhen.
